topic: 过去、计划与入门复测 · Independent new scenario: a short past visit and a future plan
grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: A Short Visit and a Weekend Plan
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创阅读材料（模拟练习，非官方雅思测试）。请先阅读短文，然后完成8道题。题目均为英文，解释为中文。注意区分新学语法（was/were, be going to）和复习内容（常用过去式、because、基础句型）。
passage: Last Saturday, Lily visited her grandmother. The weather was sunny and warm. They were in the garden. Lily was happy. Her grandmother was happy, too. They picked red apples. Then they made apple pie. It was very good. Lily said, "Thank you!" Now Lily is going to visit again next Sunday. She is going to bring a book. They are going to read together. Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken. She is going to arrive at ten o'clock. She is going to stay for lunch. She is going to go home at four o'clock.

questions.prompt: When did Lily visit her grandmother?
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“Last Saturday, Lily visited her grandmother.”，所以是上周六。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday, Lily visited her grandmother.

questions.explanation: 短文说“The weather was sunny and warm.”，所以天气晴朗温暖。
questions.evidence: The weather was sunny and warm.

questions.prompt: Where were Lily and her grandmother?
questions.explanation: 短文说“They were in the garden.”，所以她们在花园里。
短文说“They picked red apples.”，所以她们摘了红苹果。
短文说“Then they made apple pie.”，所以她们做了苹果派。

questions.prompt: When is Lily going to visit again?
questions.explanation: 短文说“Now Lily is going to visit again next Sunday.”，所以是下周日。
questions.evidence: Now Lily is going to visit again next Sunday.

questions.prompt: Why is Lily going to take the bus?
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken.”，所以是因为自行车坏了。
questions.evidence: Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken.

questions.prompt: What time is Lily going to arrive? (Write one word or number.)
questions.explanation: 短文说“She is going to arrive at ten o'clock.”，所以到达时间是十点。
questions.evidence: She is going to arrive at ten o'clock.

vocabulary.example: Last Saturday, Lily visited her grandmother.
The weather was sunny and warm.
Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken.
She is going to arrive at ten o'clock.
She is going to stay for lunch.

grammar.title: was/were 与 be going to
grammar.explanation: was/were 是 am/is/are 的过去式，表示过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。be going to 表示计划或打算，结构是 am/is/are + going to + 动词原形。because 用来说明原因。
grammar.example: The weather was sunny and warm. They were in the garden. Lily is going to visit again next Sunday.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去时用 was。
questions.evidence: The weather was sunny and warm.

questions.prompt: They ___ in the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: She ___ going to buy a new phone.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，be going to 用 is。
questions.evidence: She is going to bring a book.

questions.prompt: We ___ going to watch a movie tonight.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，be going to 用 are。
questions.evidence: They are going to read together.

questions.explanation: 主语是 He，过去时用 was。

questions.prompt: I ___ going to visit my friend tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，be going to 用 am。
questions.evidence: Lily is going to visit again next Sunday.

questions.prompt: The children ___ happy at the party.
questions.explanation: 主语是 The children（复数），过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: She is going to study English ___ she wants a good job.
questions.explanation: 后半句是原因，用 because 连接。
questions.evidence: Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken.

part1: Did you visit a family member last week?
What was the weather like yesterday?
Are you going to do something fun next weekend?
speaking.part2: Describe a short visit you made or a plan you have. You should say:
part2_bullets: where you went or will go
who was with you or will be with you
what you did or will do
why it was or will be special
part3: Do you often visit your family?
What are you going to do next holiday?
Was your last weekend good? Why?
Do you like to plan things? Why or why not?

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about a past visit and a future plan. Use was/were, be going to, and because. (Example: Last week, I was at my friend's house. We were happy. Next week, I am going to visit my aunt because it is her birthday.)
